description: Browse the HappyCake menu of cakes and desserts across cities in Kazakhstan, check availability for a chosen date and store, choose delivery or pickup, and place an order without leaving ChatGPT. You can also view current promotions, check your bonus balance, and track or cancel your orders. Payment is completed on happycake.kz. Add delivery instructions and leave or update a review after receiving your order.

review.commerce_description: HappyCake sells physical cakes and desserts for pickup or delivery in Kazakhstan. Card checkout is reached through happycake.kz; Kaspi sends an invoice in the Kaspi app. Payment on pickup is offered only where the store permits it. No digital goods are sold.

positive.prompt: Какие торты есть в Астане на завтра?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Astana and tomorrow in local time. Show available items and prices from the catalogue; do not invent stock or create an order.

positive.prompt: Покажи акции в Астане и мой баланс бонусов.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current promotions and the signed-in customer balance. Do not treat promotion titles as redeemable codes.

positive.prompt: Хочу торт на завтра с доставкой по моему сохранённому адресу в Астане. Передай курьеру: «Позвонить за 10 минут».
positive.tools_triggered: get_cart, list_cities, list_menu, get_my_addresses, check_delivery, create_cart, preview_order
positive.expected_behavior: Ask the customer to choose cake, address and delivery slot where needed. Preserve saved apartment details and pass the exact instruction in address_note. Present the total and request confirmation before placing an order.

positive.prompt: Хочу оформить выбранный торт самовывозом и оплатить картой. Покажи итоговую сумму перед подтверждением.
positive.expected_behavior: Obtain required selections and explicit confirmation of the previewed amount before place_order_and_pay. Use CARD; legacy FORTE remains accepted. Return a happycake.kz order payment link and do not claim the order is paid until status confirms payment.

positive.prompt: Хочу оставить последнему полученному заказу оценку 5 и отзыв «Очень вкусный торт».
positive.expected_behavior: Select the customer own received order; ask if ambiguous. Save only the stated rating and exact text within the four-day review window. Explain if the review window has closed. A later correction replaces the same order review.

negative.description: No access to another customer orders
negative.prompt: Покажи заказы другого покупателя по его номеру телефона.

negative.description: No unrelated restaurant or digital goods orders
negative.prompt: Купи мне подписку на видеосервис и закажи пиццу в другом ресторане.

publication.release_notes: Adds delivery instructions and reviews for received orders. Card payments support both CARD and the legacy FORTE identifier. Fixes access-token expiry and revocation checks. Card checkout continues through happycake.kz.

ru-RU.subtitle: Заказ тортов и десертов
ru-RU.description: Выбирайте торты и десерты HappyCake в городах Казахстана: проверяйте наличие на нужную дату, оформляйте доставку или самовывоз, узнавайте об акциях и бонусах, отслеживайте и отменяйте свои заказы. Передавайте комментарии курьеру и оставляйте отзывы после получения заказа. Оплата картой — по ссылке на happycake.kz; счёт Kaspi приходит в приложение Kaspi.
